P72-PP-661 PAX Dosing Pump 1 Discharge High Temperature RTD

A_HH = Trip the dosing pump
A_Hi = Warning


RTD wired directly to the DCS.
Range is based on the IOM of the temperature sensor as provided by the vendor.
Alarm levels to be confirmed during pump commissioning as temperature reading is dependent on application conditions e.g fluid temperature/pump speed etc. 
Normal A_HH alarm is set 10 deg C above the nominal running temperature of the fluid during operation. PAX required storage temperature below 32 deg C prior decomposition
No masking required on high temp
